title: eriocaulon septangulare f. rollandii
intro: Eriocaulon septangulare f. rollandii, commonly known as Rolland's pipefish plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Eriocaulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rolland's pipefish plant are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
